description:
A member of Squad 777 who draws throngs of customers to Coin Rush.
Nothing gives her greater pleasure than dressing herself up as a bunny, and she takes an immense amount of pride in her crowd-pleasing shows.
Unlike her diffident sister, Blanc is an exuberant extrovert.

lines.text: A bit of luck, just for you.
Get ready for showtime! Featuring the twin bunnies!
My sister and I are polar opposites, but that makes it all the better when we appear together.
I'd be more than happy having you join me and Noir.
You understand how we feel, don't you, Pit Boss?
You want to touch my tail. Then should I stick it out... like this?
Fortune is fleeting. Let's hurry and start a new game.
I honestly enjoy spending time with you just doing nothing. I never tire of your company.
Have you seen Noir? It's been 10 minutes since I last saw her.
I don't wear this outfit all the time, you know. I'm merely maintaining a professional appearance in front of you.

I sometimes do shows at the theater during the holidays. 
Would you like to come see my next show?
The Bunny Girl of Coin Rush, Blanc! I'll bring you luck.
I feel amazing! I bet I could serve 10 drinks on a tray, no problem.
I'll return the favor by putting on an amazing show!
With this, I'll be able to make so many more people happy!
Wow, I'm so happy! But how am I supposed to share half of this with Noir?
Today is my lucky day.
Did you really give one of these to Noir as well?
Because it's you, I wouldn't mind if you hog all of my luck.
I'm all yours, Pit Boss, body and mind.
If I'm fond of you, I'm sure Noir will be too. What do you say the three of us go on a date together someday?
Is it a bet? Then count me in!
You look even more handsome out in the open, Pit Boss.
I feel like we're gonna hit the jackpot with these guys.
Game on!
I'll share my luck with everyone.
As long as you have me, you'll never lose this round.
I'm not scared, so long as Noir is here with me.
Getting ready.
I've got to protect my sister.
A bunny girl never loses.
It's time, Pit Boss!
Showtime for Noir and Blanc!
Everyone put your luck together and let 'em have it!
That was lucky!
Lucky!
I'm on a hot streak today.
Agh!
Noir...!
Whoa.
Noir... I'm sorry I'm leaving you behind.
I may look like a bunny, but I'll take on anyone, anytime, anywhere!

Pit Boss!
Do you think this dress suits me?
Noir and I are going to take a bath in the hot spring.
New clothes... New hairstyle... I like it!

I could stay here with you forever.
Oh, and Noir, too!

I am so happy that I get to spend Christmas with you, Pit Boss.
This Christmas is gonna be the luckiest ever!

Emma taught me how to give massages.
Maybe I can give you one later?

Are you going to be here soon?
If not, can I go hang out with Noir for a while?

Hurry up and get here, Pit Boss!
You, me, and Noir all need to take a soak in the hot spring.
Noir and I are going to Snowfield. Would you like to join us?

What I wouldn't give to go back to Snowfield again...
When do you think we'll get another chance?

Everybody is looking at me...
Maybe because I'm wearing something other than my bunny girl suit?

I'm Blanc, the lucky white bunny!
Would you like to join me in the lucky hot spring?

I feel like I'm full of luck!
Maybe it's because I am wearing a new suit.
I'm gonna turn Snowfield Hot Spring into a place bursting with luck.
Luck energy, recharged!
Is this a Christmas gift?

Wow! Thank you, Pit Boss!
I'll take it with me every day at Snowfield.

Whoa... Is this really for me?
I'll give you something too when I return to Coin Rush.

I think the reason I like Snowfield so much is...
because I can be with you all the time, Pit Boss.
I'll never change the way I feel about you.
After Noir, you're the person I cherish most, Pit Boss.
Leave it to me!
Do you need me to share some luck with you?

Ugh...
Moving isn't so easy without my bunny suit...
Misfortune has found us!
Don't get hurt, Pit Boss!
I'll protect you!
Let's finish this battle then back to Snowfield Hot Spring!
Reloading!
Ugh, this clothing is so cumbersome.
I'm going as fast as I can.
Pit Boss, now's the time!
Lady Luck is always on our side!
Luck is reserved for those who are prepared!
One and done!
Easy peasy!
Nice!
Ooof!
Ow...
Agh!

Pit Boss,
Noir and I have to go back to Coin Rush...
Now it's hot spring time!
I'll give you luck and victory to go with it!

This is a special uniform for cheering at baseball games. 
Does it suit me?

Noir? Of course, she came with me.
After all, the bunny twins wouldn't be complete with just one of us!
How do I look? It feels different from usual, don't you think?

Pit Boss, let's go on a date to the baseball stadium sometime.
Noir's coming too, of course!

Have you heard of Kiss Cam? 
When a couple shows up on the big screen, they're supposed to kiss!
I'll be practicing my swings.

Where are you, Pit Boss?
Your luck's gonna run dry if you keep hiding!
Would building a baseball field in the Outpost be too unrealistic?

Wow, it really hits me again just how massive the Outpost is.
I mean, we could totally play baseball here!

Have you ever seriously considered setting up a batting cage?
I bet it'd be a big hit.
The white rabbit who brings luck and victory is here!
My batting average might go up now.
I can feel the luck getting stronger and stronger.
Luck charged!
I wish every day were this infused with luck.

Oh, what's this? A gift coming right into my strike zone?
I love it!

Foul ball!
Hehe, just kidding, Pit Boss. I'd never toss away a gift from you.
You keep throwing me all these emotional fastballs.
That's three outs already...
That's it. I'm calling Noir over.
All right, I'm all warmed up.
Which hand signal is it again... Oh, right. That one.
Time to run the bases.
I'm up at bat!
Let's play ball!
Let's play fairly!
Batter up!
Time! Time!
I'm warming up!
I'll tidy up the batter's box real quick!
Bases loaded! Time to settle this!
I'm hitting a home run!
Clear the bench!
Out!
Jackpot!
We won!
Ouch!
Argh...!
I'm sorry. I'll go back to the dugout.
We had to use the Mercy Rule.
Welcome to the train of happiness, the AZX!
I'm Blanc, your attendant for the day! It's my pleasure to serve you!
My sister is on the train too! See if you can find her!
I've never worn a uniform like this before. What do you think? Does it look good on me?
Riding the AZX with you feels like going on a trip, Pit Boss. I'm so excited.
I'm gonna give you the VIP treatment, Pit Boss! But keep it a secret between us.
See you later! I'm going to see if any of our passengers need anything.
Pit Boss! It's almost time for the train to depart! Hurry back quickly!
I bet someday, trains will stop at the Outpost train station.
The train station at the Outpost is so quaint. I love it!
I've never worked as a cabin attendant before, but I think it's a good fit for me. I'd love to do it again if I get the chance.
I'll share lots of good luck with all my passengers!
I feel so much lighter now!
Now I'll be able to keep my cool in any situation.
Now I'll be able to provide a more comfortable experience for more passengers!
Wow, thank you! Noir will love it too.
I thought you were giving me your ticket, but a present? That's so thoughtful of you!
Thanks to you, Pit Boss, my journey today has become even more special!
This is bad. I'm supposed to be working, but I keep getting distracted by you, Pit Boss.
Did you know? You're already a VIP passenger in my eyes, Pit Boss.
You'll stay with me until the final stop, won't you?
All aboard! The train is departing soon!
Did you buckle your seat belt?
Chugga chugga choo choo! Here we go!
Let's get this show on the road!
Hold on to your seats! Things might get bumpy!
Onward to a new destination!
Full speed ahead, AZX!
Your drinks are coming right up!
Thank you for waiting!
I'll provide only the best service!
Pit Boss, now!
I'll make your trip a happy one!
Lots of luck and happiness!
Nice!
Obstacle cleared!
Full steam ahead!
Ah!
Ugh!
That hurt!
I'm sorry I couldn't take you safely to your destination...
This trip was so satisfying! What do you think, Pit Boss?
